explanation.definitionFit: A run on a mountainside for downhill skiing is a gradient that is normally under snow.

clue.text: Shot provider of duff gen on country at war briefly

indicators.note: in an across clue one part on another comes after it
briefly means cut short, so the country loses its last letter

parts.note: Syria was in civil war when the puzzle appeared

indicators.note: duff is British slang for faulty or useless, so the letters are mangled

parts.note: gen is British slang for information

explanation.surface: Someone supplying bad intelligence on a war-torn nation, in short.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Shot' suggests gunfire alongside war; it is an injection.
explanation.definitionFit: A syringe delivers injections, which are colloquially called shots, as in a flu shot.
